# GitHub Copilot instructions

For UI design, implementation, or review tasks, read and apply the relevant guidance in [docs/UI_UX_IMPROVEMENT_GUIDE.md](../docs/UI_UX_IMPROVEMENT_GUIDE.md). Use judgment: stay within the user's request, preserve the existing product direction, and do not add unrelated UI or collect student personal data.

Follow the project rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), especially its CareerBridge audience, privacy, and catalogue-accuracy requirements.
